Border Radius Generator

Organic blob shapes with an 8-handle radius editor.


    

    

      
      
    

  





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Drag the eight sliders to shape each corner.
  2. Watch the preview update live.
  3. Click Randomize for a surprise organic blob.
  4. Copy the border-radius CSS into your stylesheet.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What do the eight sliders control?
The eight values are the horizontal and vertical radius of each of the four corners: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.
Does the slash syntax work in all browsers?
Yes — the slash syntax (horizontal radii / vertical radii) works in all modern browsers.
How do I make a random blob shape?
Click Randomize to get a surprise organic shape, then fine-tune the sliders.
